comment: SSOT for the WASM crate list (PBI 2026-09-21-18). Consumers: scripts/build-wasm.mjs (npm run build:wasm), scripts/postprocess-wasm-glue.mjs, wxt.config.ts build:publicAssets, .github/workflows/ci.yml wasm gate (via scripts/wasm-crates.mjs). Adding a crate = append one entry here; no other enumeration file may list crates. publicShip=false means STAGED: built + postprocessed + src-committed, but never copied to public/wasm, never shipped via publicAssets, never cmp-gated (sentence-dedup). PBI 2026-09-21-26: the crate universe is crates + libCrates (design A: second array, not a kind field — build/stash/restore/check/publicShip iterate crates only, so lib-only entries cannot leak into gates). libCrates holds build-exempt libs (js-strings: cargo test only, never wasm-pack). paritySuites maps each build crate to its TS parity suite dirs (single owner of the CI fresh/committed vitest arg list); every build crate must have an entry, lib crates must not. pkgDts/dtsCopy are null for pii-sanitizer because its src d.ts (piiSanitizerWasm.d.ts) is hand-maintained, not copied from pkg.
